changes.defect: linear_solves and direct_solve_calls are charged +6 before a fallible exec.map_ordered over LuFactorization::solve. LuFactorization::solve fails on non-finite RHS (NonFinite) or non-finite output (LinearSolve). Sequential map stops at the first failure, so 6 are charged while 1..6 were entered; Rayon collect into Result may cancel unspecified siblings, so the executed set is nondeterministic while the charge is 6.
changes.behavior_after: Sequential: charge each solve immediately before entering LuFactorization::solve and stop at the first error (prefix-only, matching the RHS policy). Parallel: every one of the six solve jobs is joined inside an Ok envelope, all six are charged, and the first error in stage order is returned. Success path: unchanged values and counters (6 solves, 6 direct_solve_calls, 1 factorization).
